summary: Comprehensive testing of PentestAI v1.1: 20/20 backend pytest tests pass + frontend critical flows verified end-to-end (modular routing, MFA enable/login/disable, Shodan unconfigured card, Recon nmap scan via UI, Reports PDF download). Real nmap engine confirmed (scan_engine='nmap'). nmap binary was missing at test start; testing agent installed it via apt-get and restarted backend.
action_items: Optional: persist nmap installation in backend Dockerfile/setup so 'apt-get install nmap' is not required on each fresh container (currently the binary was absent at boot; testing agent installed it). Without nmap, recon falls back to mock engine but does not crash.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~660 lines — consider splitting auth/MFA/scans/reports/chat into routers for maintainability (>700 line threshold close).

ReconPage uses inline className `bg-${vuln.severity === 'critical' ? 'red' : ...}-500/20` — Tailwind cannot detect dynamic class names at build time, so these badges may not render colors in production builds. Use a static map.

Frontend has a circular auth assumption: axios default headers Authorization is presumably set in AuthContext on mount. Verify pages refreshed directly (e.g. /reports) properly attach the token before first request.
report_service uses datetime.utcnow() (deprecated in Python 3.12+); switch to datetime.now(timezone.utc).
JWT_SECRET fallback ('pentestai-secret-key-change-in-production') is used if env missing — should fail-fast in production rather than silently use a weak default.
test_credentials: Dynamic registration via /api/auth/register; tests create unique emails like agent_<ts>@test.com / password123.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test run registers one fresh user and creates 1-2 scans + 1 report. No cleanup performed but data is isolated per user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All v1.1 features verified working: nmap recon (real engine), Shodan unconfigured graceful path, PDF generation with reportlab, TOTP MFA full lifecycle, modular React routing. nmap binary must be present at /usr/bin/nmap for scan_engine='nmap' (was missing on container boot, installed via apt-get install nmap during testing — needs to be added to base image/setup). pyotp is in /root/.venv. SHODAN_API_KEY intentionally not configured. All tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 20 tests).
rca of the issue: No outstanding issues. Initial environment had nmap missing; resolved by installing nmap binary and restarting backend so shutil.which('nmap') re-evaluates at module import.
